problem_statement: Our CSV reader takes a stream in chunks and must produce the same records whatever the chunk size is: a record ends at a newline that is outside quotes, a quoted field may itself contain newlines, and two quote characters inside a quoted field mean one literal quote. Today the results depend on where the chunks fall — records whose quoted fields straddle a boundary come out split or merged. Make chunking invisible, and treat a stream that ends with a quoted field still open as malformed: that must raise ValueError rather than hand back a truncated record, while a quote closed at the very end is fine.
